answer: Each new agent locks collateral and may settle only after three unaffiliated buyers sign delivery receipts. Those receipts are timestamped at a saffron clearinghouse and cannot be moved to another name. If one wallet is found underwriting many receipts, every implicated bond is slashed to a nadir and billing rights lapse for a season. A crystal index of bonds, receipts, and slashes is posted daily, so recycled proofs are visible. Because an alias cannot inherit another agent's bond or receipts, a sybil swarm must fund real work and post fresh collateral for every extra name.
